question: If 6 sec θ = 10, then find the value of (5 cosec θ - 3 cot θ)/(4 cos θ + 3 sin θ).
solution:
**Given: **

6 sec θ = 10

**Concept:**

Sec θ = 1/cos θ,

cosec θ = 1/sin θ,

cot θ = cos θ/sin θ

**Calculation:**

6 sec θ = 10

⇒ sec θ = 10/6

⇒ cos θ = 6/10 = 3/5

⇒ sin θ = √(1 - cos² θ) = √(1 - 9/25)

⇒ sin θ = √(16/25)

⇒ sin θ = 4/5

⇒ cosec θ = 1/sin θ = 5/4

⇒ cot θ = cos θ/sin θ = 3/5/4/5 = 3/4

Put the values in (5 cosec θ - 3 cot θ)/(4 cos θ + 3 sin θ)

⇒ (5 × 5/4 - 3 × 3/4)/(4 × 3/5 + 3 × 4/5)

⇒ (25/4 - 9/4)/(12/5 + 12/5)

⇒ (16/4)/(24/5)

⇒ 5/6

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
